title: Atharva Veda (अथर्ववेदः)
author: Atharvan & Angiras Rishis
description: The fourth Veda containing ancient mantras, hymns for well-being, philosophical insights, and Vedic incantations.

title: Vaimanika Shastra (वैमानिक शास्त्र)
author: Maharshi Bharadwaja
description: An ancient Sanskrit treatise on aeronautics, vimana construction, metallurgy, propulsion systems, and ancient Indian mechanical engineering.

title: Vivekachudamani (विवेकचूडामणिः)
author: Adi Shankaracharya
description: Famous 580-verse Sanskrit poem by Adi Shankaracharya explaining Self-realization, discrimination (Viveka), and Advaita Vedanta philosophy.
